openSource.description: LogHome is powered by the OpenLogHome open-source project. Report an issue, improve the docs, contribute code, or introduce the community to an interested friend—every contribution helps.
openSource.note: A place born from shared passion.

questions.title: What can I read here?
questions.answer: LogHome is made for fans of Minecraft and its creative culture. The library includes novels, manga, and worldbuilding.

questions.title: Where do I start writing?
questions.answer: Open Write to enter your personal studio, create a work, and add chapters. Follow the page if you need to log in.

questions.title: Do I have to download the app?
questions.answer: No. You can read, write, and join discussions on the web. The Android app is simply another option.

questions.title: Can I contribute without writing code?
questions.answer: Absolutely. Reporting issues, improving documentation, and introducing LogHome to other fans are all valuable contributions.

seo.title: LogHome — Minecraft fanfiction and creative community
